source: oracles/uapki/library/uapkic/src/dstu7624.c dstu7624_gmac_self_test (programmatically extracted). All 5 official vectors are exactly one block long - the ISO/IEC 7816-4 padding-marker branch (non-block-aligned messages) is untested by any official vector, see docs/DECISIONS.md D-57. Single-block input also means these vectors cannot disambiguate multi-block chaining order - D-57 documents a real off-by-one bug found in this same source file (streaming gmac_update/gmac_final, not ported) and the chunk-invariance argument used instead to confirm the multi-block Horner chain this module implements (ported from the one-shot encrypt_gmac, the coherent construction). uapki-only: no Bouncy Castle standalone GMAC class exists (confirmed by search - only GCM-configured KGCMBlockCipher tests, which do not exercise this AAD-less single-stream construction).
